note: Довідник для слота connection_to_capstone. Курс має назвати, до якого з шести критеріїв він готує студента, і до якого типу проєкту це застосовне.

criteria.name: Problem Definition & Relevance
criteria.description: Clarity and relevance of the problem or opportunity addressed. Contextual understanding of the industry or organizational challenge, including war, post-war and EU integration challenges.
criteria.assessmentFocus: Can the student define a meaningful and relevant challenge with clear business implications?

criteria.name: Analytical Depth and Methodology
criteria.description: Quality and appropriateness of the methods and tools used, qualitative or quantitative. Soundness of analysis and conclusions.
criteria.assessmentFocus: Are frameworks and models applied correctly? Is the analysis robust and evidence-based?

criteria.name: Solution Design & Feasibility
criteria.description: Innovativeness, practicality and implementability of the proposed solution. Alignment with the defined problem. Correctness of financial calculations.
criteria.assessmentFocus: Are business and financial models feasible and coherent? Is the solution actionable and scalable?

criteria.name: Implementation Plan & Execution Readiness
criteria.description: Quality and clarity of the implementation strategy: operational model, organizational structure, required resources, timeline and milestones, risk assessment and mitigation.
criteria.assessmentFocus: Can the student translate the solution into a realistic execution plan? Have they considered risks and organizational impact?

criteria.name: Quality of Materials & Presentation
criteria.description: Quality of the written report and oral presentation. Structure, clarity, visual design, persuasiveness. MVP readiness.
criteria.assessmentFocus: Can the student explain complex ideas to stakeholders? Is an MVP in place?

criteria.name: Reflection on Tools, Learning Process and Personal Growth
criteria.description: Quality of self-reflection on the learning process, challenges faced and the personal leadership journey.
criteria.assessmentFocus: Can the student reflect on the use of MBA tools and models, and on their own growth and mistakes?

deliverables.calculations: MS Excel, з таблицями й графіками, вбудованими у Word

plagiarismThreshold.consequence: Понад 20% — робота не допускається до захисту. Після повторної перевірки з результатом ≤20% допускається, але із застосуванням знижувального коефіцієнта 10%.
